 Oral Order

(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE VIPUL M. PANCHOLI)
13 10-01-2025 I.A.- 1/2021

At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since more than 7 years and the applicant has been convicted for committing offence punishable under Section 376 of I.P.C. as well as under the provisions of the POCSO Act.

He, therefore, urged that in view of the provisions contained in Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
the present appeal be fixed for hearing and the same be disposed of.
2.
In view of the aforesaid submission, Office is directed to prepare the paper-book and thereafter list the appeal under the caption 'For Hearing' in the week commencing from Patna High Court CR.
3. As this Court has fixed the appeal for hearing, learned counsel for the applicant does not press the present application for the present.
